name: IWF National Championship
epitaph: Taken from Johnny Rage by Crusher at WrestleFest '97, in Rage's first defense in weeks.

name: IWF United States Championship
epitaph: Defended successfully by "King" Kevin Payne against Destroyer at WrestleFest '97.

name: IWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Taken from AJ "Black Ice" Stanson by Derrick DaMann in the main event of WrestleFest '97.

name: WOW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Taken from the Prophet by Jeremy "Roadkill" Thranton at WrestleFest '97.

name: IWF/WOW North American Championship
epitaph: Defended successfully by "Trouble Man" Martin Richards against the Desert Scorpion at WrestleFest '97, when both men were counted out.

name: IWF/WOW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Defended successfully by Body Count against America's Least Wanted at WrestleFest '97.

name: IWF/WOW North American Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Awarded for the first time at WrestleFest '97, when Helter Skelter won a tournament final over Horror.

name: IWF/WOW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: A single unified world title billed by the promotion's own 1999 bulletins, standing where the 1997 supercard had crowned two separate, parallel World Heavyweight lineages; no document in the held record records the unification itself.

name: IWF/WOW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: First attested in the promotion's own 1999 bulletins, contested in handicap and special-stipulation matches alongside the World Heavyweight title.

name: IWF/WOW US National Championship
epitaph: First attested in the promotion's own 1999 bulletins, defended on its weekly cards.
